Major AI Developments.summary: The Hartford has launched its first Global Technology Centre in Hyderabad, India, covering 1,60,000 sq. ft. and focusing on AI, digital innovation, and engineering. The centre plans to scale up to 1,200 employees, supporting the company's global technology transformation. This marks The Hartford's entry into India, with Hyderabad serving as its first home in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: Congress slams Centre for ‘excluding’ opposition from AI summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Congress has criticized the Centre for allegedly excluding opposition parties from an AI summit. The exclusion has sparked controversy, with the Congress accusing the Centre of being non-inclusive. The incident highlights a perceived lack of cooperation between the government and opposition parties on key issues like AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: Telangana govt prepared to meet challenges posed by rapid rise of AI: IT Minister
Major AI Developments.summary: The Telangana government is prepared to address the challenges arising from the rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI). According to the IT Minister, the government is taking steps to meet these challenges. The minister's statement highlights the government's proactive approach to navigating the impact of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: CM to PM: We need AI war room, AI ministries
Major AI Developments.summary: A chief minister has proposed the creation of an AI war room and AI ministries to the prime minister. The suggestion aims to leverage artificial intelligence for the country's development and growth. The proposal highlights the need for a dedicated framework to harness the potential of AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Telangana banking on AI to open new career avenues, says minister Sridhar Babu
Major AI Developments.summary: Telangana is leveraging artificial intelligence to create new career opportunities, according to Minister Sridhar Babu. The state aims to utilize AI to open up fresh avenues for employment and growth. Minister Babu highlighted the potential of AI in driving innovation and job creation in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: AP ties up with IBM, BharatGen & NxtGen for Swadeshi AI stack
Major AI Developments.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government has partnered with IBM, BharatGen, and NxtGen to develop a "Swadeshi AI stack". This collaboration aims to create an indigenous artificial intelligence ecosystem. The partnership is expected to drive innovation and growth in the state's AI sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Univs must become architects of indigenous AI solutions, says guv Jishnu Dev Varma
Major AI Developments.summary: Governor Jishnu Dev Varma emphasized the importance of universities becoming architects of indigenous AI solutions. He stressed the need for universities to take the lead in developing AI solutions tailored to local needs. This approach aims to promote self-reliance and reduce dependence on foreign AI technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Telangana views AI safety as an enabler of innovation: Sridhar Babu
Major AI Developments.summary: Telangana views AI safety as a means to drive innovation, according to Sridhar Babu. This perspective is expected to foster growth and development in the region. The state's approach to AI safety is seen as an enabler, rather than a hindrance, to technological advancements.

Major AI Developments.title: 60TB billing data, 1.77 lakh restaurant IDs: How AI uncovered Rs 70,000 crore tax evasion scam starting with Hyderabad biryani chains
Major AI Developments.summary: An Income Tax investigation into Hyderabad biryani chains uncovered a massive tax evasion scam across India's food and beverage industry. The probe analyzed 60 terabytes of billing data and found suppressed sales turnover of at least Rs 70,000 crore since 2019-20. The scam involved deletion and under-reporting of cash transactions, affecting over 1.77 lakh restaurant IDs across the country.

Major AI Developments.title: End-to-end adoption of AI expedites drug development timelines, say leaders at BioAsia conference in Hyderabad
Major AI Developments.summary: Leaders at the BioAsia conference in Hyderabad stated that adopting AI from start to finish can accelerate drug development timelines. This end-to-end AI adoption is expected to significantly impact the pharmaceutical industry. The conference highlighted the potential of AI to revolutionize the drug development process, making it faster and more efficient.

Major AI Developments.title: AI in Romance: How Gen Z Uses AI for Dating App Messages and Love Notes
Major AI Developments.summary: Gen Z is using AI to assist with dating app messages and love notes, viewing it as a tool to translate genuine feelings into words. AI is being leveraged for tone checks, smoother communication in long-distance relationships, and to boost confidence in expressing affection. The use of AI in romance has seen a significant rise, particularly among dating app users.

Major AI Developments.title: UK firm opens its new AI-first Global Capability Centre in Hyd
Major AI Developments.summary: A UK-based firm has launched its new AI-first Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad. The centre is expected to leverage artificial intelligence to drive innovation and growth. This move marks a significant expansion of the company's presence in India, focusing on AI-driven technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: Hyderabad hospital launches AI-enabled clinic as experts flag rising head, neck cancer burden in India
Major AI Developments.summary: A hospital in Hyderabad has launched an AI-enabled clinic to address the growing burden of head and neck cancer in India. Experts have flagged a rising incidence of these cancers in the country, prompting the need for advanced treatment facilities. The AI-enabled clinic aims to provide improved diagnosis and treatment options for patients.

Major AI Developments.title: Western Union partners HCLTech to open AI-led global capability centre in Hyderabad
Major AI Developments.summary: Western Union has partnered with HCLTech to open an AI-led global capability centre in Hyderabad. The centre will leverage artificial intelligence to drive innovation and growth for Western Union. This collaboration aims to enhance Western Union's global operations with advanced technology and expertise.

Major AI Developments.title: Google rolls out AI-powered photo editing feature in India
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has launched an AI-powered photo editing feature in India, allowing users to edit images in Google Photos using voice or text prompts. The feature, powered by Gemini, supports multiple Indian languages and offers conversational editing tools. It also provides personalised editing options for users.

Major AI Developments.title: Telangana Launches Aikam, Global AI Innovation Entity, at Davos
Major AI Developments.summary: Telangana has launched Aikam, a global AI innovation entity, with the goal of placing the region among the top 20 global innovation hubs. Aikam aims to achieve this through AI workforce development. The launch took place at Davos, a prominent international gathering.

Major AI Developments.title: L’Oréal to pump Rs 3,500 cr in 1st AI-driven global tech hub in Hyderabad
Major AI Developments.summary: L'Oréal is investing Rs 3,500 cr in its first AI-driven global tech hub, located in Hyderabad. The hub will be the company's first of its kind, leveraging artificial intelligence to drive innovation. This significant investment underscores Hyderabad's growing importance as a technology hub.

Major AI Developments.title: UPC Volt to set up AI ready data centre at Telangana’s Bharat Future City; ₹5,000 crore investment over 5 years estimated
Major AI Developments.summary: UPC Volt is setting up an AI-ready data centre at Telangana's Bharat Future City with an estimated investment of ₹5,000 crore over 5 years. The facility is expected to create over 3,000 jobs during construction and more than 800 jobs during operation. The data centre will be a significant addition to the region's infrastructure, driven by AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: Telangana Unveils Life Sciences Policy 2026–30 at Davos, Targets $25 Bn Investments
Major AI Developments.summary: Telangana has unveiled its Life Sciences Policy 2026-30 at Davos, aiming to attract $25 billion in investments. The policy proposes the development of 10 Pharma Villages and the expansion of Genome Valley and the Medical Devices Park. This initiative is expected to boost the region's life sciences sector through strategic infrastructure development and investment.

Major AI Developments.title: Hyderabad Emerges as Global Beauty Tech Hub with L’Oréal’s Largest GCC Investment
Major AI Developments.summary: Hyderabad is emerging as a global beauty tech hub with L'Oréal's largest investment in a Global Capability Centre (GCC). The new GCC represents an initial investment of ₹3,500 crore. This investment establishes Hyderabad as a key location for beauty tech innovation and development.

Major AI Developments.title: Unilever Considers GCC in Hyderabad, Cites City’s Growing Global Appeal
Major AI Developments.summary: Unilever is considering Hyderabad as a potential location for its Global Capability Centre (GCC) operations. The company is drawn to the city's growing global appeal, indicating its increasing attractiveness as a business hub. Hyderabad's emergence as a key destination is a significant factor in Unilever's decision to evaluate the city for its GCC operations.

Major AI Developments.title: Indian start-ups unveil breakthrough AI tools for mass health screening
Major AI Developments.summary: Indian start-ups have developed innovative AI tools for mass health screening, marking a significant breakthrough in the field. These AI-powered tools aim to enhance the efficiency and accessibility of health screenings, potentially benefiting a large population. The introduction of these tools is expected to revolutionize the healthcare sector in India and beyond.

Major AI Developments.title: AI hype reversal could bring back FIIs to India creating huge upside
Major AI Developments.summary: A potential reversal of the global AI investment boom could redirect foreign capital towards India. India's limited exposure to AI infrastructure and strong macro fundamentals may offer significant upside when markets refocus on fundamentals. This shift could bring back Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) to India, creating a huge upside.

Major AI Developments.title: T-Hub selects 10 startups to drive AI, semiconductor innovation in India
Major AI Developments.summary: T-Hub has selected 10 startups in partnership with the UK Government's 'UK-India Emerging Tech Exchange Programme' to drive innovation in AI and semiconductors. The chosen startups include Alice Camera, B-Secur, and StarBuzz.AI, among others, and will leverage the capabilities of both India and the UK in these fields. The partnership aims to provide a robust platform for these startups to grow and collaborate.

AI Start-Up News.title: Hyderabad startup Superclaims uses AI to speed up health insurance claims
AI Start-Up News.summary: Hyderabad-based startup Superclaims has developed an AI-powered platform to speed up health insurance claims, reducing adjudication time from days to minutes. The platform processes over 100,000 claims monthly, improving accuracy and cutting operational costs. It also helps insurers detect fraudulent claims, making the claims process more efficient.

AI Start-Up News.title: Piper Serica leads seed round in deep tech startup eNLife Research
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deep tech startup eNLife Research has raised Rs 6 crore in a seed funding round led by Piper Serica VC Fund. The funds will be used to develop its blood-based biomarker platform, expand its R&D team, and advance its diagnostic assay. eNLife Research aims to create affordable, AI-powered diagnostic platforms to detect neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's.

AI Start-Up News.title: ekincare acquires claims adjudication SaaS platform Superclaims
AI Start-Up News.summary: Digital health platform ekincare has acquired Superclaims, an AI-powered claims adjudication SaaS platform. The Superclaims leadership team will continue in their roles and report to ekincare's senior leadership, with the brand operating independently. The acquisition aims to unlock new growth opportunities by expanding ekincare's platform and distribution network.

AI Start-Up News.title: CDFD-incubated Acubiosys harnesses AI for psoriasis, diabetic inflammation drugs
AI Start-Up News.summary: Hyderabad-based start-up Acubiosys has launched AI-driven medicines for psoriasis and diabetic inflammation. The medicines utilize nanotechnology and are plant-based, developed with incubation support from the Centre for DNA Fingerprinting and Diagnostics (CDFD). Acubiosys' innovative approach combines AI with nanotechnology to create new treatments for these conditions.

AI Start-Up News.title: Fintech startup Kalpi raises seed round from Rainmatter Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Hyderabad-based fintech startup Kalpi has raised Rs 3.75 crore in a seed funding round from Rainmatter Capital. The funds will be used to strengthen the team, improve product capabilities, and expand distribution across retail and institutional segments. Kalpi is building a rule-based systematic investing platform for retail and institutional investors, founded in 2025 by Ashwar Gupta.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI-powered R&D platform for consumer products; Demand for AI talent spikes in India
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deeptech startup Bettrlabs is using AI to digitize product development for consumer brands, streamlining the process from idea to formulation. The demand for AI talent in India is increasing, with Bengaluru leading in AI hiring, followed by Hyderabad. Tier II cities are also emerging as hubs for AI talent in the country.

AI Start-Up News.title: Prashant Pitti’s Optimo Capital raises Rs 100 Cr from PNB
AI Start-Up News.summary: Optimo Capital, a tech-led NBFC, has raised Rs 100 crore in debt funding from Punjab National Bank and partnered with Godrej Finance to co-lend Rs 200 crore over 12 months. This development comes six months after the company secured Rs 150 crore in equity funding led by Blume Ventures and Omnivore. Optimo Capital focuses on MSME lending, offering digital secured loan-against-property products to borrowers with limited access to formal credit.

AI Start-Up News.title: CM Revanth Reddy moots AI Start-up Village in Telangana, AI War Room...
AI Start-Up News.summary: CM Revanth Reddy has proposed the establishment of an AI Start-up Village in Telangana. He also suggested setting up an AI War Room to foster innovation and development in the field of artificial intelligence. The initiatives aim to promote AI growth and entrepreneurship in the region.

AI Start-Up News.title: Global HealthX crosses $15 Mn in healthcare investments, unveils startup cohort
AI Start-Up News.summary: Global HealthX, a healthcare and life sciences innovation hub, has surpassed $15 million in investments across startups and studio-built ventures over the past two years. The platform operates at the intersection of healthcare, life sciences, and technology to address gaps in India's healthcare ecosystem. Global HealthX aims to improve access, affordability, and continuity of care through its integrated model of venture studio, strategic investments, and market-access partnerships.

AI Start-Up News.title: US startup sets eyes on real-world AI applications in India
AI Start-Up News.summary: A US startup is focusing on real-world AI applications in India, with a significant portion of its research and development taking place in Telangana. The company, which is listed on Nasdaq, has nearly 300 employees, with half of them based in India. The startup develops programmable AI processors and software for devices and data centres.

AI Start-Up News.title: IIIT-Hyderabad uses AI to decode the Indian thali
AI Start-Up News.summary: Researchers at IIIT-Hyderabad are developing an AI-powered system to analyze the Indian thali, a meal with diverse textures and overlapping ingredients. The system aims to decode the complex composition of the thali using artificial intelligence. The research was recently presented at the 16th Indian Conference on Computer Vision, Graphics and Image Processing 2025.

AI Start-Up News.title: Sarvam AI signs MoU with TN Govt to set up  sovereign AI park with ₹10,000 cr investment
AI Start-Up News.summary: Sarvam AI has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Tamil Nadu government to establish a sovereign AI park. The project is expected to attract an investment of ₹10,000 crore. This initiative aims to promote AI development and innovation in the region.

AI Start-Up News.title: T-Hub and Hexagon selects 12 Startups for LAB32 Cohort, Driving Innovation in AI and Digital Reality
AI Start-Up News.summary: T-Hub and Hexagon have selected 12 startups for the LAB32 cohort, a 100-day program focused on AI and digital reality innovations. The program will provide mentorship, guidance, and support in areas such as go-to-market strategies and predictive maintenance using AI models. The selected startups were chosen from over 230 applications and will have access to market opportunities, including the potential to partner with Hexagon.
